
# Build the best bet into the Payments project
$ shep opportunity build cd0cb908-5869-4caa-b9cc-142dec6865a3 --project payments
√ Building Faster guest checkout as work item 142e803d-3ee3-4de6-8e7f-dbc677be0488

# When the work item is done, shep ships the opportunity (or by hand)
$ shep outcome ship cd0cb908-5869-4caa-b9cc-142dec6865a3
√ Faster guest checkout shipped; its outcome is judged on 2026-10-19
$ shep outcome ship 3bd51e9b-2adc-44d8-9af3-678a7db44456
√ PO number on invoices shipped; its outcome is judged on 2026-10-19
